mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT(p.id) id,p.parent_id AS pid,p.perm_name AS title,p.perm_url AS url,p.level,p.cate,p.sort,p.code FROM safety_sys_role_perm rp INNER JOIN safety_sys_perm p ON rp.perm_id=p.id AND p.cate BETWEEN 1 AND 9 WHERE rp.role_id = #{roleId} ORDER BY p.level,p.sort
